File Hash Checker

Compute real SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 and SHA-512 hashes of any file with the Web Crypto API — and verify against an expected hash.

Hashed locally with the Web Crypto API — your file never leaves this device.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose a file and a hash algorithm.
  2. The real cryptographic hash is computed locally.
  3. Paste an expected hash to verify integrity.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How are hashes computed?

The file is read into memory and hashed with crypto.subtle.digest, the browser's native Web Crypto implementation — the same algorithms servers use.

Why is there no MD5?

MD5 and other legacy hashes are not exposed by the Web Crypto API, so only the SHA-2 family (plus SHA-1) is available natively.

How does verification work?

Paste the expected hash and the tool compares it case-insensitively, ignoring spaces and colons, then shows MATCH or MISMATCH.

Is my file uploaded anywhere?

Yes — hashing happens entirely on your device; the file is never uploaded.
